instruction: Change the VLC recording folder to save to the Videos directory

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC preferences and changing the recording folder from default to /home/user/Videos. Uses existing is_vlc_recordings_folder metric to verify the VLC config file has been updated with the correct recording path. Added postconfig to close VLC so config is saved before evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts VLC config file from platform-specific location (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux)
Metric logic correctly parses VLC config file and checks input-record-path setting against expected value
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - directly accesses rule['recording_file_path'] which is correct for expected.type='rule'
Postconfig appropriately kills VLC and waits to ensure config is saved before evaluation
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (VLC recording folder path)
Expected value /home/user/Videos is semantically correct for 'Videos directory' on Linux
Robust error handling for missing files, parse errors, and missing config keys
Data flow is correct: config extraction -> file parsing -> path comparison -> match result
